syllabus.title: Syllabus
syllabus.description: What each olympiad subject covers, and where to learn each topic.

descriptions.informatics: Algorithms, data structures and problem solving, as set for the national informatics olympiad.
descriptions.astronomy: Celestial mechanics, observation, astrophysics and the sky, as set for the astronomy olympiad.
descriptions.physics: Mechanics, waves, heat, electricity and modern physics, as set for the physics olympiad.

syllabus.subtopicsNote: These subtopics are Project Cherenkov's own breakdown of the topic above. The source syllabus does not list them.

provenance.heading: Where this comes from
provenance.intro: Project Cherenkov writes this syllabus itself, from the sources below. Each topic is labelled with the syllabuses that list it.
provenance.unofficialGloss: Names in {language} are unofficial glosses written by Project Cherenkov, so check the source if in doubt.
provenance.ownWork: What is Project Cherenkov’s own: the subtopics, the translations into the other language, and the pairing of a topic with a source that does not state it itself. Section pointers such as “IPhO §2.4.3” name the place in the source where a topic comes from.

coverage.label: {covered} of {total} topics have a material or an editorial
coverage.legend: Each label says which syllabuses list the topic. “Not confirmed” means we have not found the topic in that source; it does not mean the topic is excluded.
coverage.notConfirmed: In the {sources} syllabus; not confirmed in the {primary} guide
